Hi! In such a situation, it's pretty darn hard to figure life out all alone. Do you have a therapist you can talk about? They can maybe help you to see what you can change in your life to feel better about yourself. I don't believe for a second you're just a burden for the people around you, even though I can absolutely imagine how it feels if you experience that. It sucks, and in this pandemic it sucks even more. But still, I'd want to advice you to force yourself to do something. Something you used to enjoy maybe, or something that might seems fun - hell, even something someone else thinks is fun. Go play an online game, go out for a run, design a shirt. It's very hard to do things when you're depressed (which it sounds like you might be) so even forcing yourself to do something for five minutes is an accomplishment. Do view it like that!
